summary: The session discusses AstraZeneca's transformation in data analytics, focusing on making data accessible to non-technical users through a new Enterprise analytics platform built on Snowflake technology. It highlights the importance of consistent data products, simplification of metrics, and the integration of AI as a digital co-worker to enhance decision-making. The speakers share insights on the challenges and successes of democratizing data access across the organization.

sections.topic: Introduction to AstraZeneca and Data Challenges
key_points: AstraZeneca's growth and complexity in data management
Importance of making data accessible to non-technical users
Introduction of the Aspire program for analytics
Creation of a unified platform for insights
AI as a digital co-worker to assist decision-making
User feedback on the new platform and its simplicity
Importance of a trusted data foundation
Training the semantic layer for better insights
The necessity of a solid data foundation for effective decision-making

key_takeaways: Establish a trusted data foundation to ensure accurate insights.
Leverage generative AI to enhance decision-making and uncover new insights.
Simplify data access for non-technical users to democratize analytics across the organization.
